q: Amazon Locker 系统最终确定要实现的核心能力有哪些？（多选）
q_en: Which core capabilities are in scope for the Amazon Locker system? (Select all that apply.)
options: 司机按包裹尺寸投递并获得取件码
用户用取件码打开对应格口
取件码 7 天后过期，过期后拒绝取件
系统负责短信或邮件通知用户
why: 系统边界只覆盖 locker 内部的投递、取件和过期判断；通知渠道被明确交给下游系统处理。过期码会被拒绝，但包裹仍占用格口直到工作人员处理。
why_en: The locker system owns deposit, pickup, and expiry handling, but notification delivery is explicitly a downstream system's job.
options_en: The driver deposits by package size and receives a pickup code.
The user opens the matching compartment using the pickup code.
The pickup code expires after seven days and is rejected once expired.
The system is responsible for sending SMS or email notifications.
optionExplanations: 司机按尺寸投递拿到取件码，这是投递流程的起点，属于系统要负责的动作。
取件码就是开对应格口的钥匙，这一步同样在系统职责范围内。
取件码到第 7 天要被拒绝，这条规则也在范围内，但拒绝开门权限不等于格口马上腾空。
容易以为系统还要负责提醒用户，但短信、邮件这类通知渠道被划给了下游系统，locker 只管生成码。
optionExplanations_en: The driver depositing by size and getting a code kicks off the flow — squarely the system's job.
The pickup code is the key to its matching door, also core to what the system owns.
Codes must lapse on day seven — in scope too, but rejecting a lapsed code doesn't instantly free the slot.
It's tempting to assume the system also pings users, but SMS/email alerts are handed to a separate downstream service; the locker just issues the code.
scenario: 设计 Amazon Locker：面试官澄清通知由下游消息服务负责，locker 只管取件码、格口和 7 天过期。
scenario_en: Designing Amazon Locker, the interviewer clarifies that notifications are handled by a downstream messaging service, so the locker only owns codes, compartments, and the seven-day expiry.

scenario: 面试官问“包裹实体要不要建模”，但系统只根据 small/medium/large 做格口分配。
scenario_en: The interviewer asks whether Package should be modeled, but the system only uses small, medium, and large for slot allocation.
q: 最合适的建模选择是什么？
q_en: What is the best modeling choice?
options: 把 Package 作为完整实体，包含收件人、物流和订单字段
不建 Package 类，把 size 当作 depositPackage 的输入
把 Package 作为 AccessToken 的子类
把 Package 存在每个 Compartment 里并让它生成 token
why: 包裹的物流和客户信息属于外部履约系统，本系统只需要尺寸。没有行为的实体会增加耦合而不提高设计表达力。
why_en: Package does not earn an entity because the locker only needs package size, while shipping details live outside the system.
whenOtherWins: 如果后续要支持同一格口多包裹、包裹 ID 查询、退回流程追踪，Package 才会变成有行为和生命周期的实体。
diagram:
classDiagram
  class Locker
  class Compartment
  class AccessToken
  class Package
  Locker --> Compartment
  Locker --> AccessToken
  Compartment --> Package
options_en: Model Package as a full entity with recipient, shipping, and order fields.
Skip a Package class and pass size as an input parameter to depositPackage.
Make Package a subclass of AccessToken.
Store Package inside every Compartment and let it generate the token.
tradeoff: 把 Package 建成完整实体 vs 把 size 当作方法输入参数

termDefinitions.meaning: 本系统里代表打开某个格口权限的凭证对象，带过期时间和格口引用。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An AccessToken is the credential object in this system that represents permission to open one compartment and carries an expiration time.

termDefinitions.meaning: locker 里的一个物理格口，用于存放包裹。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A Compartment is one physical storage slot inside the locker that holds a package.

optionExplanations: 如果后续要按包裹追踪状态、支持多包裹查询或退回流程，才值得把 Package 做成带收件人、物流字段的完整实体。
本题里 locker 只用 size 决定格口，把 size 当参数传进 depositPackage 就够，不用额外建实体。
AccessToken 表达的是访问权限，Package 表达的是货物本身，两者语义不同，继承关系会把权限和货物属性混在一起。
格口是可复用的物理容器，把 Package 存进 Compartment 会让 token 生成逻辑和格口耦合，下一次投递还得先清空。
optionExplanations_en: It's only worth making Package a full entity with recipient/shipping fields once you need to track multi-package state or returns.
Here the locker only needs size to pick a compartment, so passing size straight into depositPackage is enough — no extra entity.
AccessToken models access rights, Package models the goods — inheriting one from the other mixes permission logic with cargo attributes.
A compartment is a reusable physical slot; storing Package inside it couples token generation to the slot and forces cleanup before reuse.

q: AccessToken 为什么值得建模成独立实体，而不是普通字符串？
q_en: Why should AccessToken be modeled as its own entity instead of a plain string?
options: 它只是用于生成随机数，和业务完全无关
它代表打开格口的权限，并带有过期时间
它只是用来保存短信通知的发送状态
它只是用来表示包裹的尺寸
why: 取件码不是裸字符串，而是一个有期限的 bearer token。把过期判断放在 AccessToken 上，能让职责和数据对齐。
why_en: AccessToken deserves its own type because it couples the code, expiration, and compartment access right.
options_en: It's only used to generate a random number, unrelated to business logic.
It represents the right to open a compartment, carrying an expiration time.
It's only used to store SMS notification delivery status.
It's only used to represent the package size.

termDefinitions.meaning: 持有即可使用的凭证，谁拿到这个码就能开对应的门，不再额外验证身份。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A bearer token is a credential that grants access to whoever holds it, without further identity checks.

optionExplanations: 随机数生成器不需要建模成实体；这个说法只是想把 AccessToken 拉低成无意义的工具函数。
它绑定的是访问权限和有效期，这两点必须留在同一个对象上才好判断。
短信状态属于通知系统的职责，AccessToken 不应该替下游系统存这份数据。
包裹尺寸决定分配哪个格口，那是 Compartment/Package 关心的事，不是访问凭证要管的。
optionExplanations_en: A random-number generator doesn't need its own entity — this option just tries to shrink AccessToken into a throwaway helper.
It bundles access rights with an expiration, and those two need to live on the same object to be checked together.
SMS status belongs to the notification system; AccessToken shouldn't be the place that stores that data for a downstream service.
Package size decides which compartment to allocate — that's Compartment/Package's concern, not something a credential should track.
scenario: Amazon Locker 的取件码必须 7 天后失效，pickup 路径要靠一次查表就拿到权限和有效期。
scenario_en: In Amazon Locker a pickup code must stop working after seven days, and the pickup path needs one lookup to get both the access right and the expiry.

q: 补全取件码和包裹占用的语义：
q_en: Complete the meaning of pickup-code validity versus package occupancy:
text: 取件码过期后应被{{拒绝取件}}，但包裹仍然{{物理占用格口}}，直到工作人员取走并清理状态。
why: token 有效性和格口物理占用不是同一个状态。过期只说明用户不能再开门，不说明格口可重新分配。
why_en: Token validity and physical occupancy can diverge, so an expired code does not make the compartment available.

termDefinitions.meaning: 本系统里代表打开某个格口权限的凭证对象，带过期时间。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An AccessToken represents permission to open one compartment and carries an expiration time.

q: 判断一个状态该建在哪个类上的核心区分依据是什么？
q_en: What is the key rule for deciding which class should own a piece of state?
options: 状态是不是整数
状态是物理属性还是系统管理的关系
状态会不会出现在 API 返回值里
状态是不是可以缓存
why: 格口是否装着包裹是 Compartment 的物理属性，因此放在 Compartment 上；token 到格口的映射是 Locker 管理的系统关系，因此放在 Locker 上。
why_en: State that is intrinsic to an object, like whether a compartment physically holds a package, belongs on that object, while system-managed relationships belong on the orchestrator.
scenario: 设计 Locker 系统时，你要决定「格口是否被占用」这类状态该建在 Compartment 类自己身上，还是集中放进 Locker 维护的一个 Set/Map 里管理。
scenario_en: When designing the Locker system, you must decide whether occupancy lives on Compartment itself or in a Set/Map owned by Locker.
options_en: Whether the state happens to be an integer.
Whether the state is an intrinsic physical property or a relationship the system manages.
Whether the state shows up in an API response.
Whether the state can be cached.
tradeoff: 内在物理属性放在实体自身 vs 系统管理的关系放在 orchestrator

termDefinitions.meaning: 负责编排整体业务流程、协调多个实体的顶层对象，这里指 Locker。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An orchestrator is the top-level object that coordinates the overall workflow across multiple entities, here the Locker.

optionExplanations: 数据类型（整数/字符串）跟状态该放哪个对象无关，这是一个无关紧要的表面特征。
关键要看这份状态是对象自身固有的物理属性，还是系统在编排时维护的关系——这决定它该长在谁身上。
会不会出现在 API 里是接口设计问题，和状态该建在哪个类上是两件事。
能不能缓存是性能优化的考虑，不能拿来决定状态本该属于谁。
optionExplanations_en: Whether a value is an int or a string says nothing about which object should own it — that's a surface detail.
The real question is whether the state is intrinsic to the object itself or a relationship the orchestrator manages, and that decides where it lives.
Showing up in an API response is an interface-design question, separate from where the state should be modeled.
Cacheability is a performance concern, not a reason to decide who owns a piece of state.

scenario: 你要选择如何表示格口是否可用，且 expired token 仍要保留用于给用户返回“已过期”。
scenario_en: You need to represent compartment availability while still keeping expired tokens so the user can get an expired-code error.
q: 最适合本文范围的可用性状态放在哪里？
q_en: Where should availability state live in this design scope?
options: 完全从 accessTokenMapping 推导，不存 occupied
在 Compartment 上存 occupied/status
在 AccessToken 上存 isCompartmentFree
在 Package 上存 openedDoor
why: 包裹是否还在格口里是物理状态，和 token 是否有效不同步。让 Compartment 管理 occupied 可以避免把过期 token 错当成可用性来源。
why_en: Keeping occupancy on Compartment avoids conflating token lifetime with physical package presence.
whenOtherWins: 如果格口数量巨大且投递极高频，可以维护按尺寸分组的可用队列作为索引，但要承担同步复杂度。
options_en: Derive availability entirely from accessTokenMapping, without storing an occupied field.
Store an occupied or status field on Compartment.
Store an isCompartmentFree flag on AccessToken.
Store an openedDoor flag on Package.
tradeoff: 占用放在 Compartment（物理状态） vs 从 token map 推导（关系状态）

termDefinitions.meaning: Locker 内部维护的 token code 到 AccessToken 对象的查找表。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: accessTokenMapping is the lookup table the Locker keeps from a token code to its AccessToken object.

optionExplanations: 只看 token 是否还在 map 里当可用性来源，会把过期但包裹还在的格口误判成空闲——这里行不通。
包裹在不在格口是格口自身的物理事实，把 occupied 存在 Compartment 上，才不会被 token 的生命周期带偏。
isCompartmentFree 放在 AccessToken 上意味着一个已删除的 token 没法再告诉你格口状态，职责放错了对象。
openedDoor 放在 Package 上假设包裹对象一直存在，但本题范围里 Package 甚至不是独立实体，这个字段没处安放。
optionExplanations_en: Treating token presence in the map as the availability source misjudges a lapsed-but-still-occupied slot as free — doesn't hold up.
Whether a package sits inside a slot is the compartment's own physical fact; keeping occupied there stops it from drifting with token lifetime.
Putting isCompartmentFree on AccessToken means a removed token can no longer report slot state — the responsibility sits on the wrong object.
openedDoor on Package assumes a persistent Package object, but this scope doesn't even model Package as its own entity, so the field has nowhere to live.

q: 按正确顺序排列：为什么不能只从 token map 推导格口占用？
q_en: Put the reasoning in order: why can't occupancy be derived only from the token map?
steps: 如果把过期 token 当作无效并忽略，系统会以为格口空闲。
取件码 7 天后过期，但包裹仍在格口内。
因此 token 有效性不能等价于物理占用。
工作人员清理前，格口不应被重新分配。
why: 这个推理链是本文状态建模的关键。过期 token 仍然需要留在 map 中用于返回正确错误，但格口仍被包裹占着。
why_en: The key reasoning is that expiration changes access rights but not physical occupancy.

termDefinitions.meaning: 数据或凭证的存活时长，过期后应被拒绝或清理。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: TTL, or Time To Live, is how long a piece of data or a credential stays valid before it must be rejected or cleaned up.

scenario: locker 只有 20-50 个格口，投递量普通，面试要求代码清晰。
scenario_en: The locker has only 20 to 50 compartments, normal deposit volume, and the interview values clear code.
q: getAvailableCompartment 的默认实现应该怎么做？
q_en: What should the default getAvailableCompartment implementation do?
options: 每次扫描 compartments，找同尺寸且未占用的格口
维护三棵平衡树按尺寸和最近使用排序
把所有格口放进一个全局随机池
让 AccessToken 反向扫描寻找空格口
why: 小规模格口下 O(n) 扫描足够，代码简单且单一来源清楚。用队列索引虽可 O(1)，但同步成本不值得。
why_en: For 20 to 50 compartments, a simple scan is clearer and the performance difference is negligible.
whenOtherWins: 当一个站点有成百上千格口且投递极高频时，按尺寸维护可用队列能把查找降到 O(1)。
diagram:
flowchart TD
  A["need size"] --> B["scan compartments"]
  B --> C{"size matches and free?"}
  C -- yes --> D["return compartment"]
  C -- no --> B
  B --> E["none available"]
options_en: Scan compartments each time and return the first matching, unoccupied slot of that size.
Maintain three balanced trees sorted by size and recency.
Put all compartments into one global random pool.
Have AccessToken scan backward to find an empty compartment.
tradeoff: 简单线性扫描 vs 额外索引结构换取更快查找

termDefinitions.meaning: 线性时间复杂度，成本随格口数量等比增长。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: O(n) means linear time complexity: the cost grows proportionally with the number of compartments.

optionExplanations: 20-50 个格口的规模下，线性扫描的耗时差异小到可以忽略，还换来最简单、单一来源的代码。
三棵平衡树能拿到 O(log n) 查找，但要为几十个元素维护三份索引结构，投入产出不成比例。
随机池丢掉了尺寸信息，投递时没法保证拿到的格口尺寸匹配包裹，这条路线直接不满足需求。
AccessToken 应该只管过期判断，让它反向扫描格口会把分配逻辑塞进错误的对象里。
optionExplanations_en: At 20 to 50 compartments, the runtime gap from a linear scan is negligible, and it buys the simplest, single-source code.
Three balanced trees give O(log n) lookup, but maintaining three index structures for a few dozen elements isn't worth the payoff.
A random pool throws away size information, so deposit can no longer guarantee the slot it grabs actually fits the package.
AccessToken should only own expiration logic; making it scan compartments backward shoves allocation into the wrong object.

scenario: 实现投递流程时，司机只提供尺寸，系统要开门并返回取件码。
scenario_en: In the deposit flow, the driver provides only the package size, and the system must open a door and return a pickup code.
q: 这段伪代码最主要表达哪条业务流程？
q_en: Which business flow does this pseudocode primarily express?
codeSample:
depositPackage(size)
    compartment = getAvailableCompartment(size)
    if compartment == null
        throw NoSpace
    compartment.open()
    compartment.markOccupied()
    token = generateAccessToken(compartment)
    accessTokenMapping[token.code] = token
    return token.code
options: 先生成 token，再等用户取件时才分配格口
把过期格口直接释放给司机使用
先分配同尺寸空格口，再开门并生成 token
用同一个 token 打开多个格口
why: 投递流程把格口分配、物理开门、占用标记和 token 映射串起来。返回的是 token code，不需要返回格口号。
why_en: Deposit allocates a matching free compartment, opens it, marks it occupied, stores the token, and returns only the code.
whenOtherWins: 如果生产系统必须确认司机真的放入包裹，应拆成 reserve 和 confirm 两阶段，而不是立即生成 token。
options_en: Generate the token first, and only allocate a compartment once the user later shows up to pick up.
Release a lapsed compartment straight back to the driver.
Allocate a matching free compartment first, then open the door and generate the token.
Use one token to open multiple compartments.
tradeoff: 先分配格口再生成 token vs 先生成 token 再找格口

termDefinitions.meaning: 这里指 AccessToken 的取件码字符串。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Here, token refers to the AccessToken's pickup code string.

optionExplanations: 先发 token 会让凭证在真正拿到格口之前就存在，指向的格口后填，逻辑顺序反了。
过期格口还压着没处理的包裹，直接给司机用等于把别人的包裹让出去。
先按尺寸挑一个空格口，开门、标记占用，再生成并保存 token，返回的只是 code，流程环环相扣。
一个 token 对应一个 compartment 是访问控制的基本前提，一码多门会让谁能开哪扇门变得不可控。
optionExplanations_en: Issuing the token first means the credential exists before a compartment is even attached to it — the order runs backwards.
A lapsed compartment still has an unprocessed package sitting in it; handing it straight to a driver means giving away someone else's package.
Pick a free slot of the right size, open it, mark it occupied, then generate and store the token, returning only the code — every step chains into the next.
One token per compartment is the basic access-control premise; letting one code open many doors makes it impossible to control who can open what.

scenario: depositPackage 成功后格口门已经自动打开，司机站在 locker 前。
scenario_en: After depositPackage succeeds, the compartment door has already opened and the driver is standing at the locker.
q: 返回值为什么只需要 token code？
q_en: Why does the return value only need the token code?
options: 因为 token code 不能被通知系统使用
因为系统不需要保存 token
因为司机不需要知道哪个门，打开的门就是目标格口
因为用户必须自己猜格口号
why: 硬件开门是主要反馈，司机看到开门格口即可放包。token code 被返回给上游或通知系统转交给用户。
why_en: The opened door identifies the compartment physically, so deposit only needs to return the access code.
whenOtherWins: 如果投递不是面对实体柜机完成，而是远程预约格口，返回 compartmentId 或 reservationId 会更合理。
options_en: Because the token code can't be used by the notification system.
Because the system doesn't need to store the token.
Because the driver doesn't need to know which door — the door that opened is the target compartment.
Because the user has to guess the compartment number.
tradeoff: 只返回 token code vs 同时返回格口号
optionExplanations: 通知系统当然要用 token code 转发给用户，这个说法本身就说反了。
系统必须保存 token 才能在 pickup 时查到对应格口，这个前提是错的。
硬件已经把门打开摆在司机面前，谁的门用眼睛就能看到，接口不需要额外把格口对象吐出来。
用户不需要猜——取件时是靠输入取件码让系统去查，不是靠格口号定位。
optionExplanations_en: The notification system needs the token code to forward it to the user — this option gets the direction backwards.
The system must keep the token around to look up the matching compartment at pickup — this premise is wrong.
The hardware already leaves the door open in front of the driver, so the API doesn't need to hand back a compartment object too.
Users don't guess anything — pickup works by entering the code and letting the system look up the slot, not by a compartment number.

scenario: 用户输入取件码，系统需要区分空值、未找到、过期和有效取件。
scenario_en: The user enters a pickup code, and the system must distinguish empty, missing, expired, and valid codes.
q: pickup 的核心顺序是什么？
q_en: What is the core order of the pickup flow?
options: 直接打开所有格口，再检查 token
校验 code 非空、查 token、检查过期，再开门清理状态
只检查格口是否 occupied，不需要 token map
先删除 token，再判断是否过期
why: pickup 是访问控制流程，先拒绝无效或过期 token，再对有效 token 开门并释放格口。顺序错误会产生安全或状态一致性问题。
why_en: Pickup must validate the token before opening the compartment and clearing state.
whenOtherWins: 如果是工作人员维护流程，可以不走用户 token 校验，而通过后台权限打开过期格口。
diagram:
sequenceDiagram
  participant U as User
  participant L as Locker
  participant M as tokenMap
  participant C as Compartment
  U->>L: pickup(code)
  L->>M: find token
  L->>C: open
  L->>C: clear package
  L->>M: remove token
options_en: Open every compartment first, then check the token.
Validate the code isn't empty, look up the token, check expiry, then open the door and clear state.
Only check whether the compartment is occupied, without needing the token map.
Delete the token first, then check whether it had lapsed.
tradeoff: 先校验 token 再开门 vs 先开门再校验
optionExplanations: 跳过校验直接开所有格口，等于把访问控制放在检查之后，顺序整个反了。
先挡掉空输入和查不到的 token，再判断是否过期，最后才碰硬件开门和清理状态，这个顺序把风险判断放在动作前面。
只看 occupied 会漏掉过期但没被清理的格口，也没法给用户返回明确的过期错误。
先删 token 再判断过期，逻辑上已经把证据销毁了，压根没法再检查过期与否。
optionExplanations_en: Skipping validation and opening every door puts access control after the action — the order is backwards.
Reject empty/missing codes first, then check expiry, and only then touch the hardware and clear state, so risk checks happen before any action.
Checking only occupied misses a lapsed-but-uncleaned slot and can't return a clear lapsed-code error to the user.
Deleting the token before checking expiry destroys the evidence you'd need to make that check at all.

scenario: 成功取件后需要防止同一取件码再次开门。
scenario_en: After a successful pickup, the same pickup code must not be able to open the door again.
q: 这段 clearDeposit 代码维护了哪两个状态？
q_en: Which two states does this clearDeposit code maintain?
options: 只把 token 标记为过期，不释放格口
只关闭门，不改变任何内存状态
释放物理格口，并删除 token 映射
把 token 移到 usedTokens 以支持精确错误
why: 成功取件后格口可再分配，token 也不应继续有效。漏掉任一步都会造成可用性或安全状态不一致。
why_en: Successful pickup must free the compartment and remove the token mapping together.
whenOtherWins: 如果产品明确要求区分“已使用”和“从未存在”，可以保留 usedTokens 或在 token 上加使用状态。
options_en: Only mark the token as expired without freeing the compartment.
Only close the door without changing any in-memory state.
Free the physical compartment and remove the token mapping.
Move the token into a usedTokens set to support precise error messages.
tradeoff: 同时释放格口并删除 token vs 只做其中一步
optionExplanations: 只标记过期不释放格口，会让格口永远卡在 occupied，没人能再用它。
只关门不改内存状态，token 依然留在 map 里，同一个码还能再开一次门——安全漏洞。
markFree 释放物理格口，remove 删掉 token 映射，两个状态一起清才不会留下悬空引用。
usedTokens 是没写在这段代码里的额外结构，属于以后想更精确报错时才加的东西。
optionExplanations_en: Only marking it lapsed without freeing the slot leaves the compartment stuck occupied forever, unusable by anyone.
Only closing the door without touching memory state leaves the token in the map, so the same code could open it again — a security hole.
markFree releases the physical slot and remove() deletes the token entry, clearing both together so nothing is left dangling.
usedTokens isn't in this snippet at all; it's an addition you'd only reach for if you wanted a more precise error message later.

q: 补全过期时间规则：
q_en: Complete the expiration-time rule:
text: AccessToken 的 expiration 应设置为生成时刻加 {{7 天}}；isExpired 通常比较 {{now >= expiration}}。
why: 7 天是产品给定的固定 TTL 目标，不是估算公式的结果；它决定 AccessToken 必须自带 expiration 字段并提供 isExpired 判断，而不是把过期逻辑散落在调用方。
why_en: The seven-day window is a given product target rather than a calculated figure, so AccessToken must own an expiration timestamp and expose an isExpired check.
scenario: AccessToken 的过期时间是产品给定的固定目标（7 天），不是从流量或容量推导出来的公式结果；pickup 时必须用它做 isExpired 判断。
scenario_en: AccessToken expiration is a fixed product target of seven days, not a formula derived from traffic or capacity; pickup must use it for isExpired checks.

termDefinitions.meaning: 数据或凭证的存活时长，过期后应被拒绝或清理。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: TTL, or Time To Live, is how long a piece of data or a credential stays valid before it must be rejected or cleaned up.

scenario: 用户在第 8 天输入原取件码，包裹还没有被工作人员取走。
scenario_en: On day eight, the user enters the original pickup code, and staff has not removed the package yet.
q: 系统应该如何处理？
q_en: How should the system handle this?
options: 直接打开格口，把状态标记为已释放
把错误当成普通无效码，不提示已过期
自动把包裹转移到其它可用格口
返回过期错误，但保留 token 与占用状态
why: 过期码不能开门，但包裹仍占用格口。保留 token 让系统能给出“已过期”的可解释错误。
why_en: An expired pickup should be rejected while keeping the compartment occupied until staff removes the package.
whenOtherWins: 如果安全策略要求不暴露码是否曾经存在，可以把过期和无效都显示为通用错误，但内部仍要保留清理状态。
options_en: Open the compartment directly and mark its state as released.
Treat it as a generic invalid code without mentioning expiry.
Automatically move the package to another available compartment.
Return an expired error, but keep the token and the occupied state.
tradeoff: 保留 token 便于诊断 vs 立即释放格口提高可用性
optionExplanations: 直接开门还标记释放，等于把还没被工作人员处理的包裹直接判给了任何知道旧码的人。
把过期码当普通无效码，用户会以为码打错了，反而找不到该联系谁处理包裹。
自动转移包裹需要机械臂或人工介入，这已经超出基础范围能做到的动作。
返回明确的过期错误，同时格口继续保持占用，等工作人员来处理，这样状态和现实保持一致。
optionExplanations_en: Opening the door and marking it released hands the still-unprocessed package to anyone who still has the old code.
Treating a lapsed code as a generic invalid one leaves the user thinking they mistyped it, with no clue who to contact instead.
Auto-moving the package would need a robotic arm or staff intervention — beyond what this base scope can do.
Return a clear lapsed-code error while the slot stays occupied, so the state matches reality until staff handles it.

scenario: 工作人员要处理所有过期未取包裹，并把它们退回寄件方。
scenario_en: Staff needs to handle all expired, unclaimed packages and return them to the sender.
q: openExpiredCompartments 为什么不应该直接调用 clearDeposit？
q_en: Why shouldn't openExpiredCompartments call clearDeposit directly?
options: clearDeposit 只能删除未过期 token
过期包裹应立即被客户领取
工作人员打开门后仍需实际取走包裹，系统不应提前释放格口
工作人员流程不需要访问 token map
why: 开门只是让工作人员能取包，清理应发生在确认包裹已被物理移除之后。否则系统可能把仍有包裹的格口重新分配。
why_en: Staff opening expired compartments is not the same as confirming the packages were physically removed.
whenOtherWins: 如果 locker 有可靠传感器或工作人员确认 API，可以在确认移除后调用单独的 cleanupExpiredDeposit。
options_en: clearDeposit can only remove tokens that have not expired.
An expired package should be picked up by the customer immediately.
Opening the door still leaves staff to physically remove the package, so the system shouldn't free the slot early.
The staff workflow doesn't need to access the token map.
tradeoff: 开门后立即清理 vs 确认物理移除后再清理
optionExplanations: clearDeposit 没有单独区分 token 是否过期的逻辑，这个限制是编出来的。
过期包裹恰恰是没被客户按时取走才过期的，指望客户马上来是本末倒置。
开门只是给工作人员一个物理接触包裹的机会，真正清理要等确认包裹被搬走之后再做。
工作人员流程照样要靠 token map 找到该打开哪个格口，不能绕开它。
optionExplanations_en: clearDeposit has no logic that singles out lapsed tokens — that limitation is made up for this option.
A lapsed package is lapsed precisely because the customer never came for it in time; expecting them to show up immediately gets it backwards.
Opening the door only gives staff physical access; the actual cleanup should wait until the package is confirmed removed.
The staff workflow still needs the token map to know which compartment to open — it can't skip that lookup.

q: Locker 在本文设计中直接持有哪些状态？（多选）
q_en: Which state does Locker directly hold in this design? (Select all that apply.)
options: 所有 compartments
access token code 到 AccessToken 的映射
每个包裹的配送路线
短信发送队列
why: Locker 是 orchestrator，负责分配格口和 token 查找。配送路线和通知都被排除在系统边界外。
why_en: Locker stores compartments and token lookup state, while delivery routing and notification are out of scope.
diagram:
classDiagram
  class Locker
  class Compartment
  class AccessToken
  class Package
  Locker --> Compartment
  Locker --> AccessToken
  Compartment --> Package
options_en: All compartments.
A mapping from access token code to AccessToken.
Each package's delivery route.
The SMS notification queue.
optionExplanations: 要给某个尺寸找可用格口，必须直接持有全部 compartments 的引用。
pickup 靠 code 查 AccessToken，这张映射表就活在 Locker 身上。
配送路线属于上游物流系统的数据，Locker 不需要、也不该关心包裹是怎么运来的。
短信发送队列是通知系统的内部实现，和 Locker 的职责边界不搭边。
optionExplanations_en: To find an available slot of a given size, Locker needs a direct reference to every compartment.
Pickup looks up AccessToken by code, so that lookup table lives on Locker.
Delivery routing belongs to the upstream logistics system; Locker has no need — and no business — knowing how a package got there.
An SMS send queue is an implementation detail of the notification system, outside Locker's responsibility boundary.
scenario: Amazon Locker 里 Locker 类要按尺寸找空格口、按 code 找凭证；配送路线和通知归外部系统。
scenario_en: In Amazon Locker, the Locker class has to find a free slot by size and find a credential by code, while delivery routing and notifications belong to outside systems.

q: Compartment 适合承担哪些职责？（多选）
q_en: Which responsibilities fit Compartment? (Select all that apply.)
options: 保存尺寸
保存是否物理占用
执行 open 动作
决定 access token 是否过期
why: Compartment 管理物理格口的属性和状态。token 过期属于 AccessToken，整体流程编排属于 Locker。
why_en: Compartment owns physical slot properties and actions, not token lifetime decisions.
options_en: Store its size.
Store whether it's physically occupied.
Perform the open action.
Decide whether an access token has expired.
optionExplanations: 尺寸是格口的固有物理属性，理所当然存在 Compartment 上。
包裹在不在格口里也是它自己的物理事实，同样该自己管。
开门是格口这个硬件对象要执行的动作，不该交给别的类代劳。
过期判断要看的是 token 的生成时间和有效期，那些字段都在 AccessToken 上，格口管不到。
optionExplanations_en: Size is an intrinsic physical property of the slot, so it belongs on Compartment.
Whether a package sits inside is also its own physical fact, so it manages that too.
Opening the door is an action the hardware object itself performs, not something to delegate elsewhere.
Judging lapse requires the token's creation time and validity window — those fields live on AccessToken, out of Compartment's reach.
scenario: Amazon Locker 里 Compartment 是硬件格口对象，只能读自己的物理属性，拿不到 token 的签发时间。
scenario_en: In Amazon Locker, Compartment is the hardware slot object: it can only read its own physical attributes and never sees when a token was issued.

q: 为什么“已使用 token”和“从未存在 token”可以都返回 invalid？
q_en: Why can an already-used token and a never-existing token both return invalid?
options: 因为系统从不删除 token
因为已使用 token 应该能再次打开门
因为 invalid 只用于过期 token
成功取件后 token 已移除，两者都查不到
why: 用户需要知道码不能用，不一定需要知道历史原因。要区分这两种状态，需要额外 usedTokens 或 token 状态，当前范围不值得。
why_en: After successful pickup the token is removed, so reused and never-seen codes can both be treated as invalid.
options_en: Because the system never removes tokens.
Because an already-used token should be able to open the door again.
Because invalid is only used for lapsed tokens.
A successful pickup already removes the token, so both cases become unfindable.
tradeoff: 统一返回 invalid 换实现简单 vs 拆分历史原因换更精确诊断
optionExplanations: 恰恰相反，取件成功后系统会删掉 token，正因为会删，用过的码才和从没存在过的码一样查不到。
已使用的 token 绝不能再开门，否则同一个码能重复取件，这是安全漏洞，跟本题结论正好相反。
说反了——过期码走单独的 expired 错误，invalid 恰恰是留给查不到的码，无论它是用过的还是从没存在过。
取件成功那一刻 token 就从 map 里消失了，无论这码以前用过还是压根没存在过，现在都查不到同一个结果。
optionExplanations_en: The opposite is true — a successful pickup deletes the token, and it's precisely because tokens do get removed that a used code becomes as unfindable as one that never existed.
An already-used token must never open the door again, or the same code could pick up twice — a security hole, the reverse of the point here.
Backwards — an expired code gets its own expired error, while invalid is exactly what's left for codes that can't be found, whether used or never existing.
The moment pickup succeeds, the token vanishes from the map — whether the code was used before or never existed, the lookup now comes back the same way.
scenario: Amazon Locker 取件成功后立刻从 token map 删掉凭证，当前范围不维护 usedTokens 历史表。
scenario_en: In Amazon Locker a successful pickup deletes the credential from the token map right away, and the current scope keeps no usedTokens history.

scenario: 实现 generateAccessToken 时，面试官追问“code 怎么生成”。
scenario_en: While implementing generateAccessToken, the interviewer asks how the code is generated.
q: 合理回答是什么？
q_en: What is a reasonable answer?
options: 用 compartmentId 作为 code，方便猜测
所有 medium 包裹共享一个 code
使用安全随机生成短码或 UUID，并设置过期时间
用当前日期作为 code，不保存映射
why: token 是 bearer credential，真实系统应避免可预测。本文重点不是随机算法，但要明确 code 唯一、不可轻易猜到，并映射到格口。
why_en: Access codes should be generated with secure randomness and tied to an expiration and compartment mapping.
whenOtherWins: 如果只是白板伪代码，可以暂时用 generateRandomCode() 占位，但要说明真实实现需要碰撞处理和安全随机。
options_en: Use the compartmentId as the code, so it's easy to guess.
Share a single code across all medium packages.
Generate a short code or UUID with a secure random generator, and set an expiration.
Use the current date as the code, without storing a mapping.
tradeoff: 安全随机生成 vs 简单可预测方案换开发速度
codeSample:
generateAccessToken(compartment)
    code = secureRandom()      // 6-digit code or UUID
    expiration = now() + 7.days()
    return AccessToken(code, expiration, compartment)

termDefinitions.meaning: 一种几乎不会重复的唯一标识符，常用于生成不可预测的凭证码。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A UUID, or Universally Unique Identifier, is an identifier that is extremely unlikely to collide, often used to generate unpredictable credential codes.

optionExplanations: compartmentId 本身是可预测、可枚举的，把它当 code 等于让任何人都能猜中取件码。
一个 code 对应多个包裹会让系统分不清该开哪个格口，取件语义直接崩了。
安全随机源生成的短码或 UUID 碰撞概率低，配合过期时间，才配得上一个见码即用的访问凭证该有的严谨。
不存映射就没法从 code 反查格口，pickup 阶段根本无从校验。
optionExplanations_en: compartmentId is predictable and enumerable, so using it as the code lets anyone guess a valid pickup code.
One code shared across many packages leaves the system unable to tell which compartment to open — pickup semantics break.
A short code or UUID from a secure random source has low collision odds, and paired with an expiration it matches the rigor a see-it-use-it credential deserves.
Without storing a mapping, there's no way to look up the compartment from the code — pickup has nothing to validate against.

q: 补全清理状态的不变量：
q_en: Complete the cleanup-state invariant:
text: 一次有效 pickup 完成后，必须同时让 compartment {{markFree}}，并从 accessTokenMapping 中 {{remove token code}}。
why: 这两个状态一起表达“格口可再次分配且旧码不可再用”。只做其中一个会导致双重分配或重复开门风险。
why_en: Valid pickup must update both occupancy and token lookup to preserve availability and access-control invariants.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把格口标记为空闲、可再分配的方法。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: markFree is the method that marks a compartment as empty and available for reassignment.

scenario: 现在 locker 规模扩大到数千格口，每秒大量投递，线性扫描成为瓶颈。
scenario_en: The locker now scales to thousands of compartments with many deposits per second, so linear scan becomes a bottleneck.
q: 哪个优化最符合文章里的替代方案？
q_en: Which optimization best matches the alternative design?
options: 给每个 token 复制一份格口对象
把所有格口随机排序后永不更新
删除 occupied 状态只看 token 是否未过期
按 Size 维护可用 Compartment 队列
why: 按尺寸分组的队列可把查找和归还都做成 O(1)。代价是必须严格维护队列和真实占用状态一致。
why_en: A queue of available compartments per size gives O(1) allocation at the cost of maintaining an extra index.
whenOtherWins: 小型 locker 用线性扫描更清晰；优化索引只有在规模或频率证明需要时才值得。
options_en: Copy a compartment object for every token.
Randomly sort all compartments once and never update it.
Remove the occupied field and only check whether the token hasn't expired.
Maintain a queue of available compartments grouped by size.
tradeoff: O(1) 索引查找 vs 维护两份状态的同步复杂度
optionExplanations: 复制格口对象会产生两份真相源，一份更新另一份没更新，立刻出现状态不一致。
排序后不再更新等于放弃维护可用性信息，新释放的格口永远排不到前面。
只看 token 是否过期会把物理占用和访问凭证混为一谈，过期但包裹还在的格口会被误判成空闲。
按尺寸分组的队列能把查找和归还都压到 O(1)，代价是要严格同步队列和真实占用状态。
optionExplanations_en: Copying a compartment object per token creates two sources of truth — update one and not the other, and state drifts instantly.
Sorting once and never updating means giving up on tracking availability at all; a newly freed slot never bubbles back to the front.
Checking only token lapse conflates physical occupancy with the access credential — a lapsed-but-still-occupied slot gets misread as free.
A size-grouped queue makes both allocation and return O(1), at the cost of keeping the queue in lockstep with real occupancy.

q: 用 Queue 存可用格口相比 Set 的一个额外好处是什么？
q_en: What extra benefit does a Queue have over a Set for available compartments?
options: Queue 自动判断 token 是否过期
Queue 可以防止所有并发 bug
Set 不能存储 Compartment
FIFO 分配可以更均匀地分摊格口磨损
why: 队列让被释放的格口排到后面，避免总是使用同一个格口。这个好处仍然要和额外索引复杂度权衡。
why_en: A queue can distribute wear more evenly by allocating compartments in FIFO order.
options_en: A queue automatically checks whether a token has expired.
A queue prevents all concurrency bugs.
A Set cannot store Compartment objects.
FIFO allocation spreads compartment wear more evenly.
tradeoff: FIFO 磨损均衡 vs 额外索引维护成本

termDefinitions.meaning: 先进先出的处理顺序，最先放回的元素最先被取用。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: FIFO, First In First Out, processes items in the order they were added, so the earliest one returned is the next one used.

optionExplanations: Queue 只是个数据结构，判断过期是 AccessToken 该做的事，两者没关系。
并发正确性要靠锁或原子操作保证，换成 Queue 并不会自动消灭并发 bug。
Set 能存任何对象引用，包括 Compartment，这个说法本身不成立。
FIFO 让最近释放的格口排到队尾，避免总复用同一批格口，磨损更均匀，但要多维护一份索引。
optionExplanations_en: A queue is just a data structure; deciding lapse is AccessToken's job, unrelated to which structure holds available slots.
Concurrency correctness needs locks or atomic ops; swapping in a queue doesn't automatically erase race conditions.
A Set can hold any object reference, Compartment included — this claim is simply false.
FIFO sends a just-freed slot to the back of the line so the same few compartments aren't reused constantly, evening out wear at the cost of an extra index.
scenario: Amazon Locker 单点约 100 个格口，机械门有开合次数寿命上限，磨损要分摊到所有格口。
scenario_en: An Amazon Locker site has around a hundred compartments, and each mechanical door has a limited number of open-close cycles, so wear has to be spread across all of them.

scenario: 基础需求说 small、medium、large 必须 exact match，medium 满了但 large 还有空。
scenario_en: The base requirement says small, medium, and large must be exact matches; medium is full but large still has space.
q: depositPackage(MEDIUM) 应该怎么做？
q_en: What should depositPackage(MEDIUM) do?
options: 拒绝投递并返回无可用 medium 格口
自动放入 large 格口
把包裹拆成 small
生成 token 但不分配格口
why: 题目当前范围明确要求精确尺寸匹配，不做 fallback。按范围实现比提前扩展更重要。
why_en: The base requirement uses exact size matching, so a medium package is rejected if no medium compartment is available.
whenOtherWins: 如果追问 size fallback，再按 SMALL->MEDIUM->LARGE 的顺序寻找不小于包裹的格口。
options_en: Reject the deposit and report no available medium compartment.
Automatically place it in a large compartment.
Split the package into smaller pieces.
Generate a token without allocating a compartment.
tradeoff: 严格精确匹配 vs 向上尺寸 fallback
optionExplanations: 基础需求写死了精确尺寸匹配，没有 fallback 条款，medium 满了就该老实拒绝。
放进 large 格口就是隐含实现了尺寸 fallback，但题目当前范围明确没有这条规则。
拆包裹是物流层面的操作，Locker 系统管不到，也不该管。
没有格口就发 token，取件时会打开一个不存在包裹的门，状态直接错乱。
optionExplanations_en: The base requirement hard-codes exact-size matching with no fallback clause, so a full medium slot means a straight rejection.
Placing it in large silently implements a size fallback, but this scope explicitly has no such rule yet.
Repackaging is a logistics-layer operation; the locker system has no business — or ability — to do it.
Issuing a token without a compartment means pickup would open a door with no package behind it — state goes straight to garbage.

q: 如果要支持小包裹使用更大格口，正确分配链路是什么？
q_en: If small packages can use larger compartments, what is the correct allocation path?
steps: 若所有候选尺寸都没有空格口，返回 no space。
从请求尺寸开始，在有序尺寸列表中向更大尺寸扫描。
找到第一个同尺寸空格口后返回，不再继续找更大的。
绝不向更小尺寸 fallback，因为包裹可能放不下。
why: fallback 的规则是单向向上，不是任意匹配。把尺寸顺序封装在分配逻辑里，其他流程不需要改变。
why_en: Size fallback searches from the requested size upward and never assigns a smaller compartment.

termDefinitions.meaning: 首选方案不可用时，退而求其次采用的替代方案。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A fallback is the alternative approach used when the preferred option is unavailable.

scenario: 后续要求格口门可能坏掉，维护中格口不能被分配。
scenario_en: A later requirement says compartment doors can break, and compartments under maintenance cannot be assigned.
q: 最自然的模型变化是什么？
q_en: What is the most natural model change?
options: 把坏掉的格口从 accessTokenMapping 里直接删掉
让 AccessToken 多存一个维修人员电话字段
引入 CompartmentStatus 枚举替换 occupied
把 Size 这个枚举类型整个删掉
why: available、occupied、out_of_service 不再是二元状态，用 status enum 表达更准确。分配逻辑只需要检查 isAvailable。
why_en: A status enum models available, occupied, and out-of-service states better than a boolean.
whenOtherWins: 如果只需要临时忽略少数格口，也可以在 Locker 维护 disabledCompartmentIds，但状态 enum 更贴合实体状态。
options_en: Delete the broken compartment directly from accessTokenMapping.
Have AccessToken also store a maintenance contact phone number.
Introduce a CompartmentStatus enum to replace the occupied boolean.
Delete the Size enum entirely.
tradeoff: 布尔值简单 vs 枚举表达三态更准确
codeSample:
enum CompartmentStatus:
    AVAILABLE
    OCCUPIED
    OUT_OF_SERVICE

isAvailable()
    return status == AVAILABLE

termDefinitions.meaning: 限定取值范围的类型，这里用来表达格口的三种互斥状态。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An enum is a type restricted to a fixed set of values, used here to express the compartment's three mutually exclusive states.

optionExplanations: 从 map 里直接删掉格口丢失了它的物理存在，维修完想恢复都没地方查。
维修联系电话是运维系统该存的数据，混进 AccessToken 会让访问凭证背上不相关字段。
格口的状态不只是有没有包裹，还要表达坏了不能用，三态用枚举表达更准确，判断时只看 isAvailable 就够。
Size 枚举和维护状态是两回事，删掉它连基础的尺寸匹配都做不了了。
optionExplanations_en: Deleting the broken compartment straight from the map erases its physical existence — nowhere to look it up once repaired.
A maintenance contact number is data the ops system should own; bolting it onto AccessToken saddles a credential with an unrelated field.
A slot's state is more than occupied-or-not — it also needs to express being broken; a three-way enum fits better than a boolean, and allocation just checks isAvailable.
The Size enum and maintenance state are unrelated concerns; removing Size would break even basic size matching.

q: 加入维护状态后，CompartmentStatus 可能包含哪些值？（多选）
q_en: After adding maintenance state, which values might CompartmentStatus include? (Select all that apply.)
options: AVAILABLE
OCCUPIED
OUT_OF_SERVICE
TOKEN_EXPIRED
why: 维护状态描述格口本身能否分配。TOKEN_EXPIRED 是访问凭证状态，不应混进格口物理状态。
why_en: Compartment status should describe the slot's availability, not the token's lifecycle.
options_en: AVAILABLE
OCCUPIED
OUT_OF_SERVICE
TOKEN_EXPIRED
optionExplanations: AVAILABLE 描述格口本身空着能用，属于格口自己的物理状态。
OCCUPIED 描述格口里有包裹，同样是格口的物理状态。
OUT_OF_SERVICE 描述格口坏了不能分配，也是格口本身的状态。
TOKEN_EXPIRED 描述的是访问凭证的生命周期，不该混进格口自己的状态枚举里。
optionExplanations_en: AVAILABLE describes the slot itself being empty and usable, a physical state of the compartment.
OCCUPIED describes a package sitting inside, also the compartment's own physical state.
OUT_OF_SERVICE describes a broken, unassignable slot, still a state of the compartment itself.
TOKEN_EXPIRED describes an access credential's lifecycle — it doesn't belong mixed into the compartment's own state enum.
scenario: Amazon Locker 要让工作人员把坏掉的格口临时下线，投递分配时必须跳过这些格口。
scenario_en: Amazon Locker needs staff to be able to take a broken compartment offline temporarily, and deposit allocation must skip those slots.

scenario: 生产系统必须保证司机确实把包裹放进格口，不能只开门后假设成功。
scenario_en: A production system must confirm the driver actually put the package inside, not just assume success after opening the door.
q: 比单阶段 deposit 更合适的流程是什么？
q_en: What flow is better than a single-phase deposit?
options: 先给用户 token，再让司机随便找一个格口
把包裹是否存在的检查留到 pickup 时才做
所有投递都改成工作人员手工登记处理
reserve 先占位，confirm 才发 token
why: 两阶段流程先保留并开门，确认放入后才标记 occupied 并生成 token。它解决了“开门但司机离开”的空格口发码问题。
why_en: A two-phase reserve and confirm flow prevents issuing a pickup token for an empty compartment.
whenOtherWins: 在面试基础范围里，单阶段 deposit 更简单；两阶段适合需要传感器、人工确认或严格物理验证的生产系统。
options_en: Give the user a token first, then let the driver find any compartment afterward.
Defer the check for whether the package exists until pickup time.
Route every deposit through manual staff registration instead.
Reserve holds the spot; only confirm issues the token.
tradeoff: 单阶段简单 vs 两阶段确认换取物理存在保证
codeSample:
reserveCompartment(size) -> reservationId   // opens door, status=RESERVED
confirmDeposit(reservationId) -> tokenCode   // status=OCCUPIED, token issued
optionExplanations: 先发 token 再让司机随便找格口，等于访问凭证和物理位置压根没绑定，谁都不知道该开哪扇门。
把存在性检查拖到 pickup 才做，意味着中间这段时间格口可能是空的却被标记占用，账对不上。
全面转人工登记放弃了自动化的意义，量大了工作人员根本处理不过来。
reserve 先占位开门等司机放包，确认后 confirm 才发 token，这样永远不会对着空格口发码。
optionExplanations_en: Issuing the token first and letting the driver pick any compartment means the credential is never actually bound to a location — nobody knows which door to open.
Deferring the presence check to pickup means the slot could sit marked occupied while actually empty in between — the books don't match.
Routing everything through manual staff registration throws away the point of automating this at all; volume would overwhelm staff fast.
Reserve opens the door and holds the spot while the driver deposits, and only confirm issues the token, so a code is never handed out for an empty slot.

q: 两阶段投递的正确状态变化顺序是什么？
q_en: What is the correct state-change order for a two-phase deposit?
steps: confirmDeposit 根据 reservationId 找到格口。
reserveCompartment 找可用格口并标记 RESERVED。
生成 token，标记 OCCUPIED，并删除 reservation 记录。
如果超时未确认，取消 reservation 并释放格口。
why: 核心是 token 只在确认之后产生，RESERVED 状态需要超时清理。这样避免长期占用或空格口发码。
why_en: The two-phase flow reserves first, confirms before issuing the token, and times out abandoned reservations.
diagram:
stateDiagram
  [*] --> Reserved
  Reserved --> Occupied: driver confirms
  Reserved --> Available: timeout
  Occupied --> Available: pickup

termDefinitions.meaning: 预留后若超过设定时间未确认，系统自动取消预留并释放格口。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A reservation timeout automatically cancels an unconfirmed reservation and frees the compartment after a set time window.

q: invalid token 和 expired token 为什么要给不同错误？
q_en: Why should invalid token and expired token return different errors?
options: invalid 一定说明包裹被盗
expired 可以继续开门
二者必须完全一样，否则无法清理
expired 说明码曾有效，用户该联系支持
why: 过期错误告诉用户码曾有效但窗口已过，包裹仍可能需要人工处理。随机错误或已使用码则只说明当前不可用。
why_en: An expired-token error is actionable because the package may still be in the locker awaiting staff handling.
options_en: Invalid always means the package was stolen.
A lapsed token can still open the door.
The two must be identical, or cleanup becomes impossible.
Lapsed means the code was once valid but the window passed, so the user should contact support.
tradeoff: 统一 invalid 错误换简单 vs 单独 expired 错误换可操作性
optionExplanations: invalid 只说明码当前查不到，不能这样脑补出被盗结论。
过期 token 明确是被拒绝的，绝不能再开门，这个说法反了。
如果两者非要给一样的错误，系统就没法用同一个字段回答“包裹是否还在里面”这个问题。
lapse 状态说明码曾经有效，包裹很可能还在格口里，这个信息值得单独告诉用户去找支持。
optionExplanations_en: Invalid only means the code can't be found right now — that's not license to assume the package was stolen.
A lapsed token is explicitly rejected and must never open the door again — this option has it backwards.
If both had to return the identical error, the system would lose the one field that answers 'is the package still inside?'
A lapse state means the code was once valid and the package is likely still sitting in the slot, worth telling the user separately so they contact support.
scenario: Amazon Locker 用户可能输错码，也可能拿 7 天前的旧码；客服要从错误里判断包裹是否还在格口。
scenario_en: An Amazon Locker user may mistype a code or show up with a seven-day-old one, and support needs the error itself to tell whether the package is still in the slot.

scenario: 产品经理问是否要实现失败多次后锁定取件码。
scenario_en: The product manager asks whether pickup codes should be locked after repeated failures.
q: 根据本文基础范围应该怎么处理？
q_en: How should this be handled in the base scope?
options: 先不实现，只校验错误码并返回错误
必须记录每个失败尝试和时间窗口
把失败次数写入 Compartment
失败一次就永久删除 token
why: 失败锁定会引入额外状态和时间窗口，已被澄清为 out of scope。识别但不实现它，是控制范围的表现。
why_en: Failed-attempt lockout is a scoped-out security feature that would add extra state and timing rules.
whenOtherWins: 如果安全要求明确包括防暴力破解，再为 token 或用户维护失败计数、窗口和锁定状态。
options_en: Don't implement it yet — just validate the error code and return an error.
Must log every failed attempt and its time window.
Write the failure count onto Compartment.
Permanently delete the token after a single failure.
tradeoff: 先不做换保持简单 vs 提前实现锁定换安全性
optionExplanations: 失败锁定已经被明确排除在基础范围外，先返回明确错误、不额外加状态，是控制范围该有的样子。
记录每次失败和时间窗口正是被排除的那套锁定机制，属于范围外功能。
失败次数是访问尝试的数据，不是格口的物理属性，写进 Compartment 放错了对象。
失败一次就删 token 等于让合法用户打错一次字就永久丢了取件资格，这个代价太重了。
optionExplanations_en: Lockout has already been explicitly scoped out; returning a clear error without adding new state is what staying in scope looks like.
Logging every failed attempt with a time window is exactly the lockout mechanism that's been scoped out.
A failure count is data about access attempts, not a physical property of the slot — writing it onto Compartment puts it on the wrong object.
Deleting the token after one failure means a single typo permanently locks a legitimate user out of pickup — way too costly.

scenario: pickup(tokenCode) 是高频路径，输入 code 后要快速找到对应权限对象。
scenario_en: pickup(tokenCode) is a high-frequency path, so the system must quickly find the matching access object from the code.
q: Locker 应该维护哪种结构？
q_en: What structure should Locker maintain?
options: List<Compartment> 并逐个比较 code
Map<Size, Package>
Map<string, AccessToken>
单个全局 currentToken
why: code 到 AccessToken 的 map 让取件查找是 O(1)。AccessToken 再持有对应 Compartment 引用，能直接开门。
why_en: A map from token code to AccessToken gives direct lookup for pickup.
whenOtherWins: 如果存储在数据库中，map 会变成 token code 上的索引，但抽象关系仍相同。
options_en: A List<Compartment> compared one by one against the code.
A Map<Size, Package>.
A Map<string, AccessToken>.
A single global currentToken.
tradeoff: 哈希表 O(1) 查找 vs 线性列表逐个比较
codeSample:
accessTokenMapping: Map<string, AccessToken>

pickup(code):
    token = accessTokenMapping.get(code)   // O(1) lookup
    if token == null: throw InvalidCode

termDefinitions.meaning: 按 key 直接定位值的数据结构，平均查找是 O(1)。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A hash map locates a value directly by key, giving average O(1) lookup.

optionExplanations: 逐个比较 code 是 O(n) 线性查找，pickup 是高频路径，这个代价不值得。
Size 到 Package 的映射答不出“这个 code 对应哪个 AccessToken”这个问题，选错了 key。
这张映射把访问码和权限对象直接绑定，查找是常数时间，权限对象内部还留着格口引用，可以一路开到门。
全局只留一个 token 意味着同一时间只能有一个包裹在被取，locker 本该支持多个格口并发使用。
optionExplanations_en: Comparing the code one by one is an O(n) linear search; pickup is a hot path, so that cost isn't worth paying.
A size-to-Package map can't answer 'which AccessToken does this code belong to' — it's keyed on the wrong thing.
This lookup binds the access code straight to its credential object in constant time, and the credential still carries a compartment reference to finish opening the door.
A single global token means only one package could ever be mid-pickup at a time, but a locker needs many slots usable concurrently.

q: 补全 Information Expert 的职责划分：
q_en: Complete the Information Expert responsibility split:
text: Locker 管理{{分配和 token 映射}}；AccessToken 管理{{过期判断}}；Compartment 管理{{物理占用状态}}。
why: 哪个对象拥有数据，哪个对象就应该最懂如何使用那份数据。这个原则让方法短小且职责稳定。
why_en: Information Expert assigns allocation to Locker, expiration to AccessToken, and physical occupancy to Compartment.

termDefinitions.meaning: GRASP 设计原则之一：谁拥有数据，谁就该实现使用这份数据的行为。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Information Expert is a GRASP design principle stating that the object owning the data should implement the behavior that uses it.

scenario: 开发者提议 token 一过期就从 accessTokenMapping 删除。
scenario_en: A developer suggests deleting a token from accessTokenMapping as soon as it expires.
q: 为什么这会破坏需求？
q_en: Why would this break the requirement?
options: 系统无法区分过期码，工作人员也找不到格口
删除 map 会让所有格口变大
token 删除后包裹会自动消失
过期码应继续允许用户取件
why: 过期后仍要返回具体过期错误，并让工作人员找到要处理的格口。提前删除会丢掉访问和清理上下文。
why_en: Deleting expired tokens immediately loses both the ability to report expiry and the mapping needed for staff handling.
whenOtherWins: 在工作人员确认移除包裹后，可以删除 expired token 并释放格口。
options_en: The system can no longer tell a lapsed code apart, and staff can't locate the compartment either.
Deleting the map makes every compartment bigger.
The package disappears automatically once the token is deleted.
Lapsed codes should still be allowed to open the door.
tradeoff: 立即删除 token 简化 map vs 保留 token 支持过期诊断与清理
optionExplanations: 提前删掉 token 既丢了“这码曾经有效”的诊断信息，也丢了工作人员该开哪个格口的线索。
删 map 不会改变任何格口的物理尺寸，这个因果关系是编的。
token 删除和包裹是否消失是两回事，硬件里的包裹不会因为一条内存记录被删就凭空消失。
过期码的定义就是不再被允许开门，这个说法直接和过期的含义相矛盾。
optionExplanations_en: Deleting the token early loses both the diagnostic fact 'this code was once valid' and the clue staff need for which slot to open.
Deleting a map entry doesn't change any compartment's physical size — that causal link is invented.
Deleting a token and a package disappearing are unrelated; a physical package doesn't vanish because one in-memory record was removed.
A lapsed code is by definition one that's no longer allowed to open a door — this option directly contradicts what lapse means.

q: pickup 为什么可以返回 void，而不是返回 Package 或 Compartment？
q_en: Why can pickup return void instead of returning Package or Compartment?
options: 因为 pickup 不需要检查 token
因为返回 void 可以跳过清理
因为用户必须自己打开门
因为开门就是用户可见的成功反馈，不必暴露格口对象
why: locker 是与硬件联动的系统，开门就是用户可见结果。业务上不需要把格口对象暴露给调用方。
why_en: Pickup can return void because the hardware door opening is the observable success result.
options_en: Because pickup doesn't need to check the token.
Because returning void lets you skip cleanup.
Because the user has to open the door themselves.
Because the door opening is the visible success signal, so there's no need to expose the compartment object.
tradeoff: void 返回值更简洁 vs 返回对象换调用方可编程性
optionExplanations: pickup 恰恰必须先查 token 才能判断该不该开门，这个说法说反了。
返回类型和要不要清理状态没有因果关系，void 一样得完成 markFree 和删除映射。
硬件联动的门是系统开的，用户不需要也不该自己动手开门。
硬件已经把门打开当成看得见的成功信号，调用方不需要再拿到一个格口对象去做什么。
optionExplanations_en: Pickup has to check the token first to decide whether to open the door at all — this gets the order backwards.
Return type has no causal link to whether cleanup happens; a void return still has to run markFree and remove the mapping.
The hardware-linked door is opened by the system; the user doesn't and shouldn't need to open it manually.
The hardware already treats the open door as the visible success signal, so the caller has no use for a compartment object on top of that.
scenario: Amazon Locker 的 pickup 由柜机固件调用，硬件直接开门，调用方之后不再操作格口对象。
scenario_en: Amazon Locker pickup is called by the kiosk firmware, the hardware opens the door directly, and the caller does nothing further with the compartment object.

q: pickup 应显式处理哪些边界情况？（多选）
q_en: Which edge cases should pickup handle explicitly? (Select all that apply.)
options: tokenCode 为空
token 不存在
token 已过期
格口尺寸比包裹大
why: pickup 路径围绕取件码有效性和期限判断。格口尺寸是投递分配时的问题，不是取件时的主要边界。
why_en: Pickup edge cases focus on token presence and expiry, while size matching belongs to deposit.
options_en: tokenCode is empty.
The token doesn't exist.
The token has expired.
The compartment is bigger than the package.
optionExplanations: 空输入是最基本的边界，必须在查表前就挡掉。
查不到的 code 得单独返回“无效”，不能让系统崩掉或误判。
过期 token 要走专门的过期错误分支，而不是和无效码混在一起。
格口比包裹大是投递分配时该保证的匹配问题，取件时格口尺寸已经定了，不是 pickup 该检查的边界。
optionExplanations_en: An empty input is the most basic edge case, and it must be caught before any lookup.
A code that can't be found needs its own 'invalid' response, not a crash or a silent misread.
A lapsed token should follow its own dedicated error branch instead of being lumped in with invalid codes.
Slot-bigger-than-package is a matching concern deposit already guaranteed; by pickup time the slot is fixed, so it's not an edge case pickup needs to check.
scenario: Amazon Locker 的 pickup 只收用户在柜机键盘敲进来的 tokenCode，格口在投递时已经分配好。
scenario_en: Amazon Locker pickup only receives the tokenCode a user types on the kiosk keypad, and the compartment was already allocated at deposit time.

scenario: 有人想把 isExpired(token) 写成 Locker 的工具函数，而 AccessToken 只存字段。
scenario_en: Someone wants to make isExpired(token) a Locker helper while AccessToken only stores fields.
q: 更好的职责放置是什么？
q_en: Where is the better place for this responsibility?
options: AccessToken.isExpired()
Locker.isExpired(token)
Compartment.isExpired()
Size.isExpired()
why: 过期时间是 AccessToken 自己的数据，过期判断也应放在它身上。Locker 只负责调用判断并编排流程。
why_en: Expiration logic belongs on AccessToken because it owns the expiration timestamp.
whenOtherWins: 如果过期策略变成可配置业务策略，也可以抽出 ExpirationPolicy，但基础题不需要。
options_en: AccessToken.isExpired()
Locker.isExpired(token)
Compartment.isExpired()
Size.isExpired()
tradeoff: 把判断放在拥有数据的 AccessToken vs 放在编排者 Locker
optionExplanations: 过期时间戳就存在 AccessToken 身上，判断逻辑跟着数据走，改动一处就够。
把判断挪到 Locker 上，Locker 每次都要先跨对象取到 expiration 字段才能算，多绕一层。
Compartment 压根不持有过期时间这个字段，让它判断过期无从下手。
Size 只是个尺寸枚举，没有任何和过期相关的数据，这个选项属于概念乱入。
optionExplanations_en: The expiration timestamp already lives on AccessToken, so the check follows the data and only needs to change in one place.
Moving the check to Locker means it has to reach across objects to grab expiration every time — an extra hop for no benefit.
Compartment doesn't hold an expiration field at all, so it has nothing to check lapse against.
Size is just a sizing enum with no lapse-related data at all — this option mixes in an unrelated concept.

q: 补全与 Parking Lot 的状态归属对比：
q_en: Complete the state-ownership contrast with Parking Lot:
text: Amazon Locker 把占用看作{{物理状态}}，因此放在 Compartment；Parking Lot 把占用看作{{ticket 赋值关系}}，因此可放在 orchestrator 的 Set。
why: 两题都能用多种方案，关键是说清楚领域语义。不要机械套用一个固定模式。
why_en: The article contrasts physical occupancy in lockers with assignment-style occupancy in parking lots.
scenario: 在另一道经典 LLD 题 Parking Lot 中，车位是否被占用通常由 orchestrator 维护的一个 ticket→spot 关系（比如 Set）表示，而不是车位自身的字段。
scenario_en: In the classic Parking Lot LLD problem, spot occupancy is often represented by a ticket-to-spot relationship owned by the orchestrator, such as a Set, rather than a field on the spot.

termDefinitions.meaning: Parking Lot 系统里代表一次占用关系的凭证对象。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: In the Parking Lot system, a ticket is the object representing one occupancy assignment.

scenario: 你担心司机打开门后没放包，用户却收到了取件码。
scenario_en: You are worried that the driver opens the door but does not place the package, while the user still receives a pickup code.
q: 这是哪种当前设计的代价？
q_en: Which current design tradeoff causes this risk?
options: 单阶段 deposit 的假设成本
token map O(1) 查找的成本
Size enum 的成本
Compartment.getSize 的成本
why: 单阶段流程假设司机在开门后完成投递。若要消除这个假设，需要确认步骤、传感器或 reservation timeout。
why_en: The risk comes from a single-phase deposit flow that assumes the driver actually deposits the package.
whenOtherWins: 基础面试题可以接受这个假设以保持设计简洁；生产安全性更高时才引入两阶段。
options_en: The assumption cost of a single-phase deposit.
The cost of O(1) token-map lookup.
The cost of the Size enum.
The cost of Compartment.getSize.
tradeoff: 单阶段简单 vs 两阶段确认换取物理存在保证
optionExplanations: 单阶段流程默认司机开门后一定会把包放进去，这个假设一旦不成立，用户就可能拿到对着空格口的取件码。
O(1) 查找只影响查 token 快不快，跟司机到底有没有放包完全没关系。
Size enum 只用来判断尺寸是否匹配格口，不涉及司机是否真的完成了投递。
getSize 只是读一个字段，跟“门开了但包没放”这类流程风险没有因果关系。
optionExplanations_en: The single-phase flow assumes the driver actually deposits once the door opens; once that assumption breaks, a user can end up with a code for an empty slot.
O(1) lookup only affects how fast a token is found, unrelated to whether the driver actually deposited anything.
The Size enum only checks whether a size fits a slot; it has nothing to do with whether deposit actually completed.
getSize just reads a field — it has no causal link to the 'door opened but nothing was placed' risk.

q: 为什么线性扫描 compartments 在这种规模的 locker 里是可接受的设计？
q_en: Why is a linear scan over compartments acceptable at this locker scale?
options: locker 一定只有 1 个格口
所有语言扫描数组都是 O(1)
token 过期后就不需要扫描
几十个格口下 O(n)/O(1) 差异可忽略
why: 格口数量级只有几十个，O(n) 扫描和 O(1) 索引的实际耗时差异小到可以忽略；这个量级判断决定了要不要为几十个元素引入按尺寸分组的队列索引。
why_en: At the scale of a few dozen compartments, the real cost difference between an O(n) scan and an O(1) indexed lookup is negligible, so it decides whether the extra size-grouped queue index is worth building.
scenario: 一个典型 Amazon Locker 站点只有 20-50 个格口；depositPackage 每次调用 getAvailableCompartment 做一次线性扫描。
scenario_en: A typical Amazon Locker site has only 20 to 50 compartments; each depositPackage call does one linear scan in getAvailableCompartment.
options_en: A locker is assumed to always have exactly one compartment.
Array scans are O(1) in every language.
Scanning becomes unnecessary once a token lapses.
At a few dozen compartments, the O(n) vs O(1) gap is negligible.

termDefinitions.meaning: 线性时间复杂度，成本随元素数量等比增长。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: O(n) is linear time complexity, where cost grows proportionally with the number of elements.

termDefinitions.meaning: 常数时间复杂度，成本几乎不随元素数量变化。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: O(1) is constant time complexity, where cost barely changes with the number of elements.

optionExplanations: 题目场景写明是 20-50 个格口，不是 1 个，这个前提本身就错。
数组扫描是 O(n)，不是常数时间，这个复杂度判断是错的。
扫描发生在查找可用格口的阶段，和 token 是否过期是两条独立逻辑，不存在关掉扫描的说法。
几十个元素的量级下，实际耗时差异小到测不出来，这也是不用为它引入索引结构的原因。
optionExplanations_en: The scenario states 20 to 50 compartments, not one — this premise is simply wrong.
Scanning an array is O(n), not constant time — this complexity claim is incorrect.
Scanning happens while looking for an available slot; token lapse is a separate check entirely, not something that turns scanning off.
At a scale of a few dozen elements the real timing difference is too small to matter, which is also why an index isn't worth building here.

scenario: 你要实现本文选择的可用格口查找方式。
scenario_en: You are implementing the available-compartment lookup chosen for this design.
q: 这段伪代码体现了哪个设计取舍？
q_en: Which design tradeoff does this pseudocode show?
codeSample:
getAvailableCompartment(size)
    for c in compartments
        if c.getSize() == size && !c.isOccupied()
            return c
    return null
options: 用 Compartment 上的物理状态作为单一可用性来源
用 accessTokenMapping 推导占用
用每个 Size 的队列做 O(1) 分配
允许任何尺寸互相替代
why: 查找逻辑直接读取格口尺寸和 occupied 状态，保持简单。它故意不从 token 生命周期推导物理占用。
why_en: This scan uses the compartment's physical occupancy as the source of availability.
whenOtherWins: 极大规模或高频投递时，按尺寸维护可用队列会更快。
options_en: Use the compartment's own physical state as the single source of availability.
Derive occupancy from accessTokenMapping instead.
Maintain an O(1) queue of available compartments per size.
Allow any size to substitute for any other.
tradeoff: 单一物理状态来源简单 vs 从 token 生命周期推导更省内存但更复杂
optionExplanations: 代码直接读 c.getSize() 和 c.isOccupied()，可用性只认格口自己的字段，逻辑单一来源、好推理。
这段代码根本没碰 accessTokenMapping，从 token 推导占用是另一种设计，不是这里写的东西。
代码里是 for 循环挨个扫描，不是从队列里 pop 一个出来，跟按尺寸维护队列是两种实现。
循环条件写死了 c.getSize() == size，尺寸不匹配直接跳过，代码里没有互相替代的空间。
optionExplanations_en: It reads c.getSize() and c.isOccupied() directly, so availability only trusts the compartment's own fields — single source, easy to reason about.
This snippet never touches accessTokenMapping at all; deriving occupancy from tokens would be a different design, not what's written here.
The code is a for-loop scanning one by one, not popping from a queue — that's a different implementation from a per-size queue.
The loop condition hard-checks c.getSize() == size and skips mismatches — there's no substitution happening in this code.

scenario: openExpiredCompartments 扫描到多个过期 token。
scenario_en: openExpiredCompartments scans and finds multiple expired tokens.
q: 它应该对每个过期 token 做什么？
q_en: What should it do for each expired token?
options: 立刻把 compartment markFree
重新生成新 token 给客户
打开对应 compartment，让工作人员物理取包
把 token 当作无效直接删除
why: 工作人员流程的第一步是打开过期包裹所在格口。释放和删除应在确认包裹被移除后发生。
why_en: openExpiredCompartments should open the compartments tied to expired tokens for staff handling, not free them prematurely.
whenOtherWins: 如果系统有 staffConfirmRemoved(tokenCode)，那个确认方法可以再清理 token 和 occupied 状态。
options_en: Immediately mark the compartment free.
Generate a brand-new token for the customer.
Open the matching compartment so staff can physically retrieve the package.
Treat the token as invalid and delete it right away.
tradeoff: 先开门给工作人员看 vs 立即清理状态
optionExplanations: 立刻释放格口等于假设包裹已经不在了，但工作人员这时候可能还没走到那台柜机。
客户的取件窗口已经过了，重新发码只会让流程绕回起点，解决不了包裹滞留问题。
第一步只是给工作人员开门的物理权限，让他们能上手取走包裹，真正的状态清理要放在确认之后。
删 token 之后再想找到该处理哪个格口就没线索了，这一步删得太早。
optionExplanations_en: Freeing the slot immediately assumes the package is already gone, but staff may not have reached that unit yet.
The customer's pickup window has already passed; issuing a new code just loops back to the start without solving the stranded package.
The first step just grants staff physical access by opening the door so they can retrieve the package; real state cleanup comes after confirmation.
Deleting the token this early throws away the only clue for which compartment still needs attention.

q: Senior 级回答应该主动讨论哪些 Amazon Locker 取舍？（多选）
q_en: Which Amazon Locker tradeoffs should a senior-level answer proactively discuss? (Select all that apply.)
options: Package 是否需要成为实体，或只作为 token/metadata 保留
occupied 放 Compartment 还是 orchestrator/index
过期 token 的 lazy cleanup
尺寸 fallback 和坏格口扩展
无论范围如何，都应该先实现失败次数锁定安全机制
why: 高级信号是能解释范围、状态语义和演进路径，不是不顾澄清结果强行实现被排除的功能。Package 需要追踪重量、承运商或赔付时才值得建实体；范围只围绕 token 和 compartment 时，metadata 就够。
why_en: Senior answers explain entity pruning, state ownership, lazy cleanup, and extension tradeoffs, without forcing in a feature the interviewer already scoped out, like lockout.
options_en: Whether Package needs to be a real entity, or can stay as token/metadata.
Whether occupancy lives on Compartment or in an orchestrator index.
Lazy cleanup of expired tokens.
Size fallback and handling broken compartments.
Failed-attempt lockout should always be implemented regardless of scope.
optionExplanations: 能说清 Package 什么时候值得建实体、什么时候只需要 size 参数，是范围判断力的体现。
occupied 归属放对了地方，说明理解物理状态和系统关系的区别。
讲清楚过期 token 为什么不立刻删、什么时候才清理，展示了对状态生命周期的把控。
尺寸 fallback 和坏格口这些扩展方向说明候选人能预判面试官接下来会追问什么。
锁定机制已经被明确排除在范围外，不看澄清结果硬塞进设计，是过度设计而不是 senior 信号。
optionExplanations_en: Being able to say precisely when Package earns a real entity versus when a size parameter suffices shows scope judgment.
Placing occupied correctly shows the candidate understands the difference between physical state and a system-managed relation.
Explaining why a lapsed token isn't deleted immediately, and when it should be, shows control over the state lifecycle.
Raising size fallback and broken-compartment handling shows the candidate anticipating the interviewer's next follow-ups.
Lockout has already been explicitly scoped out; forcing it in regardless of that signal is over-engineering, not a senior signal.
scenario: 45 分钟 Amazon Locker LLD 面试，面试官已把通知和失败锁定划出范围，只剩 20 分钟谈深度。
scenario_en: In a 45-minute Amazon Locker LLD interview the interviewer has already scoped out notifications and failed-attempt lockout, leaving about twenty minutes for depth.

q: 按正确顺序排列 Amazon Locker 的主设计决策链：
q_en: Put the main Amazon Locker design-decision chain in the correct order:
steps: 让 Locker 作为入口，持有 compartments 和 token map。
需求只覆盖 locker 内操作，排除物流和通知。
把 AccessToken 建成带 expiration 和 compartment 引用的实体。
把 physical occupied 放在 Compartment，并在 pickup 清理。
用简单扫描查找同尺寸空格口，扩展时再考虑索引。
why: 这个链路从范围收敛开始，再落到实体、状态和性能选择。面试表达时按这个顺序更容易防止过早优化。
why_en: The design chain moves from scope to orchestrator, token entity, physical occupancy, and then allocation performance.
diagram:
flowchart TD
  A[scope pickup/deposit] --> B[Compartment owns physical state]
  B --> C[Token maps code to compartment]
  C --> D[pickup clears both]
  D --> E[handle expiry]

scenario: 面试最后问“这个设计的核心不变量是什么？”
scenario_en: At the end of the interview, you are asked: what is the core invariant of this design?
q: 最重要的不变量是哪一个？
q_en: What is the most important invariant?
options: 有效 token 对应一个占用格口，取件后两者一起清理
所有包裹都必须建成独立的 Package 对象
所有格口必须按随机顺序被分配
过期 token 自动等价于格口空闲可用
why: token 映射和格口占用必须一致，且 token 生命周期不能和物理占用混淆。这个不变量支撑投递、取件和过期处理。
why_en: The central invariant is that a valid token maps to one occupied compartment and successful pickup clears both states together.
whenOtherWins: 如果采用 reservation/confirm 两阶段，还需要增加 RESERVED 不变量和 reservation timeout 清理规则。
diagram:
flowchart TD
  A["active token"] --> B["points to occupied compartment"]
  B --> C["contains package"]
  D["pickup or expire"] --> E["remove token"]
  E --> F["clear compartment"]
options_en: A valid token maps to one occupied compartment, and pickup clears both together.
Every package must have its own Package object.
Every compartment must be assigned in random order.
A lapsed token automatically means the compartment is free.
tradeoff: 统一清理不变量 vs 允许 token/占用状态短暂不同步
optionExplanations: 凭证指向的格口和它是否被占用得对得上号，取件成功那一刻两者要一起清空，这条规则贯穿投递、取件、过期处理全过程。
范围里 Package 从没被要求建成独立对象，这个说法凭空加了一条不存在的规则。
分配顺序是线性扫描先到先得，不是随机打乱，这个描述和代码逻辑对不上。
过期只改变访问权限，不改变包裹还在不在格口里，这正是本设计要避免的混淆。
optionExplanations_en: A credential and the occupancy of the slot it points to must stay in sync, clearing together the moment pickup succeeds — that rule runs through deposit, pickup, and lapse handling.
Package was never required to be its own object in this scope — this option invents a rule that doesn't exist.
Allocation is a linear first-match scan, not a random shuffle — this description doesn't match the code.
Lapsing only revokes access, it doesn't change whether the package is still physically in the slot — that's exactly the confusion this design avoids.

scenario: 面试官只丢下一句「设计一个像 Amazon Locker 的取件柜」，你有 3-5 分钟澄清，之后就得动手写类设计。
scenario_en: The interviewer gives you one line — "design a locker system like Amazon Locker" — and you have three to five minutes of clarification before you start the class design.
q: 这几分钟的澄清提问该按什么结构组织？
q_en: How should you structure those few minutes of clarifying questions?
options: 核心操作、会出什么错、范围边界、未来扩展四个方向
先估算每天投递量、节假日峰值和存储容量，再决定技术选型
逐条复述题面里出现的每个名词，请面试官确认理解无误
先问用什么语言和框架，确定语法后再决定类怎么划分
options_en: Four directions: core operations, what can go wrong, scope boundary, future extensions.
First estimate daily deposit volume, holiday peaks and storage capacity, then pick the tech stack.
Read back every noun in the prompt one by one and ask the interviewer to confirm your reading.
First ask which language and framework, then decide how to split the classes once the syntax is settled.
why: 这四问把决定类设计的约束先钉死：尺寸严不严格匹配、满格怎么办、码怎么送达。代价是花掉 3-5 分钟编码时间，换实现阶段不返工。
why_en: Those four angles pin down the constraints that actually shape the classes — strict size matching, what happens when full, how the code reaches the customer.
optionExplanations: 先问能做什么，再问会错什么，再划边界，最后留扩展口——正好覆盖需求里会改写类设计的几处。
容量估算是高层系统设计的入口，放到只有三个类的取件柜题上，问完也影响不了类怎么分。
复述名词只确认了措辞，不会暴露「小包能不能放大格口」这类真正改设计的分歧。
语言和框架不改变实体划分；先定语法再定模型，是把最不重要的决定排到了最前面。
optionExplanations_en: Ask what it does, then what breaks, then where the edges are, then what might grow — exactly the spots where requirements rewrite the class design.
Capacity estimation is the entry point for high-level system design; on a three-class locker problem the answer changes nothing about the classes.
Reading nouns back only confirms wording — it never surfaces disagreements like "can a small package use a large compartment".
Language and framework don't change the entity split; settling syntax first puts the least important decision at the front.

termDefinitions.meaning: 范围边界，指哪些流程归本系统负责、哪些交给上下游系统。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A scope boundary is the line between what this system owns and what upstream or downstream systems handle.

scenario: 面试官确认：一个取件码只对应一个包裹。某客户同一天有 3 个包裹送到同一个 locker，各自占一个格口。
scenario_en: The interviewer confirms one access code per package. A customer has three packages arriving at the same locker on one day, each in its own compartment.
q: 取件接口该按每个包裹调一次，还是支持一次批量取？
q_en: Should pickup be called once per package, or support picking up all of them at once?
options: 每个码各调一次 pickup，各开各的门
为该客户生成一个主码，一次把他名下的格口全部打开
按客户 ID 把三个码分组存起来，pickup 改成传客户 ID
把三个包裹合并塞进同一个大格口，让它们共用一个码
options_en: Call pickup once per code; each opens its own door.
Issue one master code for the customer that opens every compartment under their name at once.
Group the three codes by customer ID and change pickup to take a customer ID instead.
Merge the three packages into one large compartment so they can share a single code.
why: 范围钉死了码与包裹 1:1，accessTokenMapping 的键就是码本身，pickup 完全不需要客户身份。代价是客户要记三个码、开三次门。
why_en: The scope fixes one code per package, so the token map is keyed by the code alone and pickup never needs to know who the customer is.
tradeoff: 无状态的单码单格口取件 vs 客户级批量取件的便利
whenOtherWins: 如果需求变成「同一订单多件必须一起取走」，就得引入客户或订单实体，把码挂到订单上做批量开门。
optionExplanations: 码本身就是钥匙，系统不认人只认码，三个包裹就是三次互不相干的取件。
主码要求系统知道码属于谁，等于凭空引入客户实体和一对多映射，超出了确认过的范围。
改成传客户 ID 后，系统必须存客户到码的关系，取件也从「验码」退化成「验身份」。
合并进一个格口违反了「各自独立格口」的澄清结论，也让分配逻辑要先算总体积。
optionExplanations_en: The code is the key — the system authenticates the code, not the person, so three packages are three unrelated pickups.
A master code requires the system to know whose code it is, inventing a customer entity and a one-to-many mapping beyond the agreed scope.
Keying on customer ID forces the system to store a customer-to-code relationship, turning pickup from checking a code into checking an identity.
Merging into one compartment contradicts the clarified rule that each package gets its own slot, and forces allocation to reason about total volume.

termDefinitions.meaning: Locker 里从取件码字符串到 AccessToken 对象的查找表，pickup 靠它一次查到权限和有效期。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: accessTokenMapping is the Locker's lookup table from code string to AccessToken object, so pickup resolves the access right and expiry in one read.

scenario: Amazon Locker 的三个实体 Locker / AccessToken / Compartment 已经定下来，接着要定每个类的字段和方法。
scenario_en: The three Amazon Locker entities — Locker, AccessToken, Compartment — are settled, and now each class needs its fields and methods.
q: 该用什么方法把需求推成字段和方法？
q_en: What method turns the requirements into fields and methods?
options: 对每个实体问两句：要记住什么、要支持什么操作
先设计数据库表结构，再把每一列一对一映射成类的字段
先给每个字段配上读写方法，把接口铺满之后再补业务逻辑
按常见属性清单先把字段列全，后面发现用不上的再逐个删掉
options_en: Ask each entity two questions: what must it remember, and what operations must it support.
Design the database tables first, then map each column one-to-one onto a class field.
Give every field a getter and setter first, fill out the interface, then add business logic.
List every field from a standard attribute checklist, then delete the ones that turn out unused.
why: 「要记住什么」推出 state，「要支持什么操作」推出 public 方法，两问的答案都要能指回需求表里的某一行。代价是接口一开始偏窄，得靠迭代补。
why_en: What it must remember gives you the state; what it must support gives you the public methods, and both answers have to trace back to a specific requirement.
optionExplanations: 两问分别产出 state 和方法，比如「取件码 7 天过期」直接推出 expiration 字段加 isExpired()。
先定表结构会把持久化模型倒灌进领域模型，Compartment 的 open() 这类行为在表里根本不存在。
读写方法铺满会让类退化成数据袋，过期判断这类逻辑就被挤到调用方去了。
先列全再删的做法产出的是没有需求出处的字段，删的时候也没有判断依据。
optionExplanations_en: The two questions yield state and methods separately — "a code lapses after seven days" gives you both an expiration field and isExpired().
Starting from tables leaks the persistence model into the domain model; behavior like Compartment.open() has no column to live in.
Filling in getters and setters first degrades the class into a data bag, pushing logic like expiry checks out to the caller.
Listing everything then pruning produces fields with no requirement behind them, and nothing to judge the pruning by.

termDefinitions.meaning: 一个类需要长期记住的数据，也就是它的字段，比如 Compartment 的 occupied 标志。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: State is the data a class has to remember over time — its fields, such as a Compartment's occupied flag.

scenario: Locker 的公开接口只有 deposit、pickup、openExpiredCompartments。有人提议再加 listOccupiedCompartments() 和 getCompartmentStatus(id)。
scenario_en: Locker's public interface is just deposit, pickup and openExpiredCompartments. Someone proposes adding listOccupiedCompartments() and getCompartmentStatus(id).
q: 该不该把这两个方法加进 Locker？
q_en: Should these two methods be added to Locker?
options: 不加：需求里找不到对应的用户动作
加：工作人员要先看到哪些格口被占用，才知道去处理哪一个
加：不把内部状态用读方法暴露出来，就没法给 Compartment 写测试
加：先把增删改查四件套补齐，以后扩展就不用再改接口了
options_en: No — there is no user action in the requirements behind them.
Yes — staff need to see which compartments are occupied before they know which one to handle.
Yes — without read methods exposing internal state you can't write tests against Compartment.
Yes — round out the full create-read-update-delete set now so extensions won't need interface changes.
why: 每个 public 方法都要指回需求里的一个具体用户动作，而工作人员那条需求已经由 openExpiredCompartments 满足了。代价是接口偏窄，真需要时再加一个。
why_en: Every public method has to map to a concrete user action in the requirements, and the staff requirement is already served by openExpiredCompartments.
tradeoff: 接口只暴露需求里的用户动作 vs 预留通用查询方法
whenOtherWins: 如果需求补上「后台看板实时展示占用率」，listOccupiedCompartments 就有了对应的用户动作，那时该加。
optionExplanations: 找不到出处的方法就没有存在理由，接口每多一个入口，就多一份要维护和防误用的表面积。
工作人员的动作是「打开过期格口取件」，门开了就是可见反馈，不需要先查一份占用清单。
测试可以直接对 Compartment 建实例断言，不必为此在 orchestrator 上开一个对外查询口。
为将来预留的通用接口一旦发布就得一直兼容，而需求变化的方向往往和当初的猜测不一样。
optionExplanations_en: A method with no requirement behind it has no reason to exist, and each extra entry point is more surface to maintain and misuse.
The staff action is "open expired compartments and retrieve" — the doors opening is the visible feedback, so no occupancy listing is needed first.
Tests can instantiate Compartment directly and assert on it, without opening a public query hole on the orchestrator.
A speculative general interface has to stay compatible once shipped, and requirements rarely evolve in the direction you guessed.

termDefinitions.meaning: 负责编排整体流程、协调多个实体的顶层对象，这里指 Locker。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An orchestrator is the top-level object that coordinates the workflow across entities, here the Locker.

scenario: depositPackage(size) 的实现里没有任何 size 合法性校验，直接调 getAvailableCompartment(size)。调用方传进一个不在 Size 枚举里的值。
scenario_en: depositPackage(size) contains no size validation and calls getAvailableCompartment(size) straight away. A caller passes a value that isn't in the Size enum.
q: 这个非法 size 会在哪里被挡下来？
q_en: Where does that invalid size get rejected?
options: getAvailableCompartment 扫不到匹配格口，返回 null
depositPackage 的第一行就该显式校验参数，遇到非法尺寸当场抛异常中止
Compartment 的构造函数会在初始化时拒绝掉这个非法尺寸
生成取件码那一步会校验尺寸，发现非法就把码立刻作废
options_en: getAvailableCompartment finds no matching compartment and returns null.
depositPackage should validate the argument on its very first line and throw on an invalid size.
The Compartment constructor rejects the invalid size at initialization time.
Code generation validates the size and immediately voids the code if it's invalid.
why: 扫描本来就按尺寸精确匹配，非法值天然匹配不到任何格口，null 直接走「无可用格口」的错误路径。代价是用户分不清是尺寸非法还是同尺寸满了。
why_en: The scan already matches on exact size, so an invalid value simply matches nothing and falls into the existing no-compartment-available error path.
tradeoff: 复用扫描的自然失败 vs 入口显式校验换来精确错误码
whenOtherWins: 如果 size 来自外部 API 的字符串，或产品要求区分「尺寸非法」和「同尺寸已满」两种错误，就要在入口显式校验。
optionExplanations: 精确匹配的扫描顺手完成了校验，非法值和「这个尺寸全满了」走同一条返回 null 的路。
多加一层校验会和扫描逻辑重复，尺寸枚举一变就有两处要同步改。
构造函数只在建 locker 时跑一次，管不到运行期一次投递传进来的参数。
生成码发生在拿到格口之后，此时非法尺寸早就在扫描那一步被拦住了。
optionExplanations_en: The exact-match scan validates as a side effect: an invalid value and "all slots of this size are full" both end in the same null.
An extra validation layer duplicates the scan's logic, so any change to the size enum has to be made in two places.
The constructor runs once when the locker is built; it never sees the argument of a runtime deposit call.
Code generation happens after a compartment is secured, by which point the invalid size was already stopped at the scan.

termDefinitions.meaning: 只含 SMALL、MEDIUM、LARGE 三个取值的类型，格口尺寸和投递参数都取自它。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The Size enum holds exactly SMALL, MEDIUM and LARGE, and both compartment sizes and deposit parameters draw from it.

scenario: Compartment 只有 open()，没有 close() 或 lock()。投递和取件两条路径都是调一次 open() 就结束，之后再没人碰这个格口。
scenario_en: Compartment exposes open() but no close() or lock(). Both deposit and pickup call open() once and never touch the compartment again.
q: 为什么这个设计不需要 close() 方法？
q_en: Why does this design need no close() method?
options: 硬件约 30 秒后自动关门上锁，软件不管闭合
关门要等客户在手机 App 上点确认之后，由通知系统触发
markOccupied() 内部顺手把门锁上了，所以不用单独暴露方法
门就一直开着，靠 occupied 标志阻止这个格口被再次分配出去
options_en: The hardware auto-closes and relocks after roughly 30 seconds; software never handles closing.
Closing waits for the customer to confirm in the mobile app, triggered by the notification system.
markOccupied() quietly locks the door too, so no separate method needs to be exposed.
The door simply stays open, and the occupied flag is what stops the slot being allocated again.
why: 系统假设门锁硬件在 ~30 秒后自己回到锁定态，软件只负责发一次解锁脉冲。代价是软件无法确认门真关上了，也无法确认包裹真放进去了。
why_en: The design assumes the lock hardware returns to a locked state on its own after about thirty seconds, so software only fires a single unlock pulse.
optionExplanations: 解锁是一次性动作，闭合归硬件的机械超时管，软件里就不该有一个它管不了的 close()。
通知被明确划到范围外，投递路径也不能依赖客户先装 App 才关得上门。
markOccupied 只改一个布尔标志，标志和门闩是两件事，把它们绑在一起会让状态含义变模糊。
occupied 只挡住软件层的再分配，门真开着的话谁都能伸手拿走包裹，物理安全就没了。
optionExplanations_en: Unlocking is a one-shot action and closing is the hardware's mechanical timeout, so software shouldn't own a close() it can't actually guarantee.
Notifications are explicitly out of scope, and the deposit path can't depend on the customer installing an app before the door will shut.
markOccupied only flips a boolean; the flag and the latch are different things, and binding them blurs what the state means.
The occupied flag only blocks reallocation in software — if the door really stayed open, anyone could reach in and take the package.

termDefinitions.meaning: Compartment 上触发物理解锁机构的方法，调用后门弹开，不负责后续关闭。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: open() is the Compartment method that fires the physical unlock mechanism; the door pops open and nothing closes it in software.

q: 按正确顺序排列：可用格口索引漏了一次 enqueue 之后会怎样？
q_en: Put it in order: what happens after the available-compartment index misses one enqueue?
steps: clearDeposit 忘了把格口 enqueue 回它尺寸对应的队列。
客户取件成功，格口物理上已经空了。
getAvailableCompartment 只认队列，从此再也拿不到它。
该格口永久退出可用池，只能重启重建索引或跑对账任务救回。
why: 改用按尺寸分组的可用队列后，队列成了可用性的唯一真相源；漏一次 enqueue 不报任何错，只让容量悄悄少一个格口。代价是修复要重启或写对账任务。
why_en: Once the index becomes the single source of truth for availability, a missed enqueue throws no error at all — capacity just silently shrinks by one slot.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把元素放回队列尾部，这里指取件后把腾空的格口重新登记为可用。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: To enqueue is to put an item back at the tail of a queue — here, re-registering a freed compartment as available.

termDefinitions.meaning: 取件成功后的清理步骤，负责腾空格口并从映射表里删掉用过的取件码。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: clearDeposit is the cleanup step after a successful pickup: it frees the compartment and removes the used code from the mapping.

scenario: Locker 改用按尺寸分组的可用格口队列做索引。一次失败重试让同一个格口被 enqueue 了两次，队列里出现两份它。
scenario_en: Locker switched to per-size queues of available compartments as its index. A failed retry enqueued the same compartment twice, so the queue holds two copies of it.
q: 这次重复登记会在什么时候露馅？
q_en: When does that duplicate entry finally surface?
options: 同一格口被分配两次，第二个司机开门时里面已有包裹
队列的长度校验会立刻报警，deposit 当场抛出重复入队错误
第二次 dequeue 拿到的是 null，deposit 会直接失败并返回无可用格口
两个取件码指向同一个格口，pickup 时系统会提示这个码已经过期
options_en: The slot is allocated twice, and the second driver opens a door with someone else's package inside.
A queue length check fires immediately and deposit throws a duplicate-enqueue error on the spot.
The second dequeue returns null, so deposit fails outright with no compartment available.
Two codes point at the same slot, and pickup tells the user the code has already expired.
why: 队列不去重，dequeue 也不回头看 occupied，所以第二次分配一路成功到生成取件码。错误直到司机开门看见别人的包裹才暴露，代价是必须人工介入。
why_en: A queue doesn't deduplicate and dequeue never rechecks the occupied flag, so the second allocation succeeds all the way through to issuing a code.
