optionExplanations: 两份副本各被 dequeue 一次，系统认为分配了两个格口，物理世界里却只有一扇门。
队列没有成员唯一性约束，长度本来就随投递取件上下浮动，没有可对比的基线来报警。
队列里确实有元素，dequeue 正常返回，失败不会在这一步显现出来。
两个码都在有效期内，过期判断只看时间戳，跟格口被重复分配毫无关系。
optionExplanations_en: Each copy gets dequeued once, so the system believes it handed out two slots while the physical world only has one door.
A queue has no uniqueness constraint, and its length already moves up and down with traffic, so there's no baseline to alarm on.
There genuinely is an element in the queue, so dequeue returns normally and the failure doesn't show up at this step.
Both codes are still within their window; expiry is judged purely on the timestamp and has nothing to do with double allocation.

termDefinitions.meaning: 从队列头部取出一个元素，这里指分配时从对应尺寸的可用队列里领走一个格口。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: To dequeue is to take an item from the head of a queue — here, claiming one compartment from the available queue for that size.

scenario: 取件码在投递后第 7 天整点到期，isExpired() 写成 now() >= expiration。客户恰好在等于 expiration 的那一毫秒输码。
scenario_en: A code expires exactly seven days after deposit and isExpired() is written as now() >= expiration. The customer types the code at the exact millisecond it equals expiration.
q: 这一刻的取件会成功还是被拒？
q_en: Does the pickup at that exact instant succeed or get rejected?
options: 被拒，等号那一刻已经算过期
成功，等号算作仍在有效期内，要到第 8 天才失效
成功，因为格口还占着包裹，占用状态优先于时间判断
被拒，并且这个码会立刻从映射表里被删掉腾出格口
options_en: Rejected — the boundary instant already counts as expired.
Succeeds — equality still counts as valid, and it only lapses on day eight.
Succeeds — the package is still in the slot, and occupancy outranks the time check.
Rejected — and the code is immediately dropped from the map, freeing the slot.
why: 用 >= 把边界那一刻划给过期，语义上有效期是左闭右开的 7 天，判定没有歧义。代价是边界上客户会觉得早了一毫秒，得走人工找回。
why_en: Using greater-than-or-equal puts the boundary instant on the expired side, making the seven-day window half-open and the check unambiguous.
optionExplanations: 等号成立时条件为真，这一毫秒起走的就是「码已过期」的错误分支，门不会开。
写成严格大于才会把等号留给有效侧，那样边界毫秒的归属就换了一边。
占用状态从来不参与取件鉴权，包裹还在只说明还得靠工作人员处理。
过期码必须留在映射表里，否则下次输入就退化成「无效码」，工作人员也找不到该开哪扇门。
optionExplanations_en: The condition is true at equality, so from that millisecond on the call takes the "code expired" branch and no door opens.
Only a strict greater-than would leave equality on the valid side, flipping which way the boundary millisecond falls.
Occupancy never participates in pickup authorization; the package still being there only means staff have to handle it.
An expired code has to stay in the map, otherwise the next attempt degrades to "invalid code" and staff lose track of which door to open.

termDefinitions.meaning: AccessToken 上的判定方法，比较当前时间和过期时间戳，决定这个码还能不能开门。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: isExpired() is the AccessToken method that compares the current time against the expiration timestamp to decide whether the code still opens a door.

scenario: 一位 junior 候选人做这道题：实体划分卡了几分钟、给了提示才理顺，投递和取件主流程跑通，边界只口头提了一句「过期码要拒」。
scenario_en: A junior candidate takes this problem: they stall a few minutes on the entity split and need a hint, get deposit and pickup working, and only mention edge cases verbally.
q: 按 junior 标准这轮该怎么判？
q_en: How should this round be judged against the junior bar?
options: 通过：主流程跑通、能讲推理，对边界有意识就够了
不通过：实体划分要靠提示才理顺，说明基础建模能力不牢
不通过：必须完整覆盖无效码、过期码、满格三类边界才算达标
通过，但要他先讲清 Information Expert 原则怎么落到这三个类上
options_en: Pass — the main flow works, the reasoning is explainable, and edge-case awareness is enough.
Fail — needing a hint on the entity split shows the modeling fundamentals aren't there.
Fail — full coverage of invalid codes, expired codes and full lockers is required to clear the bar.
Pass, but only after he explains how Information Expert maps onto these three classes.
why: junior 线是能拆出合理的类并跑通 happy path，实体设计卡住只要能讲推理、听提示能调整就可以接受。边界只要求有意识，不要求全覆盖。
why_en: The junior bar is a sensible class breakdown plus a working happy path; stalling on entities is fine as long as the reasoning is explainable.
optionExplanations: 包裹进得去、码发得出、拿码能取出来，加上知道边界存在，这就是这一档要看的全部。
卡住本身不扣分，能不能顺着提示往下推理才是这一档真正观察的信号。
三类边界全覆盖是 mid-level 的要求，拿它卡 junior 等于错配了标准。
主动讲设计原则是 senior 才被期待的动作，把它当 junior 的门槛会误伤合格候选人。
optionExplanations_en: Packages go in, a code comes out, the code retrieves them, and edge cases are acknowledged — that's the whole checklist at this level.
Stalling isn't the penalty; whether they can reason forward once nudged is the signal this level is actually watching for.
Full coverage of the three edge cases is the mid-level requirement, so applying it to a junior mismatches the rubric.
Volunteering design principles is expected at senior; using it as a junior gate fails candidates who actually cleared the bar.

termDefinitions.meaning: 一切输入合法、无异常发生时的主流程，这里指投递成功并用有效码顺利取件。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The happy path is the main flow where every input is valid and nothing fails — here, a successful deposit and a pickup with a valid code.

termDefinitions.meaning: 职责分配原则：谁拥有数据，就由谁承担使用这份数据的行为。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Information Expert is the principle that the class owning a piece of data should also own the behavior that uses it.

scenario: 一位 mid-level 候选人自己推出了三实体模型，但被问「occupied 为什么放在 Compartment 上」时说不出理由，边界只处理了无效码。
scenario_en: A mid-level candidate derives the three-entity model unaided, but can't justify why occupied lives on Compartment, and only handles the invalid-code edge case.
q: 他离 mid-level 标准还差什么？
q_en: What is still missing against the mid-level bar?
options: 差两条：辩护占用状态归属，以及补齐过期和满格边界
什么都不差，能不靠提示推出三实体模型就已经达到这一档了
差的是没写出可运行代码，只给伪代码在这一档是不够的
差的是没有主动把 Information Expert 这个原则名词说出来讲透
options_en: Two things: defending where occupancy lives, and covering the expired and full-locker cases.
Nothing — deriving the three-entity model without hints already clears this level.
Working code — pseudocode alone isn't enough at this level.
Naming and explaining the Information Expert principle proactively.
why: mid 线要求无需提示推出三实体、能为占用状态归属给出可辩护的理由，并覆盖无效、过期、满格三类边界；时间够还应自主聊一个扩展方向。
why_en: The mid-level bar is deriving the three entities unaided, defending where occupancy lives, and covering the invalid, expired and full cases.
optionExplanations: 放 Compartment 上还是放 Locker 的 Set 里都行，说不出理由才是问题；剩下两类边界也还没落地。
推出模型只完成了这一档的第一条，后面还有辩护设计选择和边界覆盖两条没过。
伪代码是这道题的默认形态，实现语言从来不是分档依据。
能讲出原则背后的取舍就够了，硬背原则名词不是这一档的评判点。
optionExplanations_en: Either placement is acceptable — the gap is being unable to defend one, and two edge cases are still unimplemented.
Deriving the model clears only the first item; defending design choices and covering edge cases are still outstanding.
Pseudocode is the default form for this problem, and implementation language was never a leveling criterion.
Explaining the tradeoff behind the principle is enough; reciting the principle's name isn't what this level scores.

termDefinitions.meaning: 职责分配原则：谁拥有数据，就由谁承担使用这份数据的行为。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Information Expert is the principle that the class owning a piece of data should also own the behavior that uses it.
